title: Deluxe 2 BD Sky Suite | South Broadway | Placemakr
description:
Welcome to Placemakr Premier SoBro, an upscale apartment-hotel delivering a one-of-a-kind experience in the heart of Nashville. Nestled in the vibrant SoBro neighborhood, our modern accommodations offer a blend of luxury and comfort. 

Enjoy being just steps away from South Broadway and minutes from Bridgestone Arena, making it easy to explore the city’s best attractions. Indulge at our on-site restaurant, Cafe Intermezzo, where you can savor gourmet dishes and specialty drinks.

The space
Our deluxe 2 bedroom sky suites are equipped with everything you need to feel at home:
• 2 bedrooms with plush queen beds 
• Stunning floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the suite with natural light
• Two full bathrooms for convenience and privacy
• Fully equipped kitchen with all the essentials for preparing your favorite meals
• In-unit laundry for added convenience during longer stays
• Private balcony
• On high floor for premium views 

Photos shown are representative; floorplans may vary.

Guest access
You’ll have full use of the building's:
•	rooftop pool 
•	community clubhouse 
•	modern fitness center
•	sauna
•	on-site support staff

Other things to note
All guests will be required to verify their identity and provide a valid credit or debit card for incidentals through our company's pre-check verification prior to check in. Prepaid cards are not accepted at this time. Guests must be at least 21 years of age to book and to check-in.

•	We will pre-authorize the guest's card for  $150
•	Government ID/National ID necessary for check-in
•	$100 pet fee applies (max of 2 pets). This fee may be collected in parts if the entire fee is not collected when booking is initially processed through Airbnb.
•	Payments for optional services not related to the cost of the room (like parking) will be collected via major credit or debit card by the company providing the service.
•	Parking is available in the same building as Placemakr Premier SoBro, but operates independently of the hotel. The SoBro Tower Garage is located at 208 3rd Ave South. Parking rates below:

0-1 hour: $10
1-3 hours: $30
3-24 hours: $50
 
You do not need to purchase parking in advance. When you pull into the garage, collect a parking ticket. Scan the QR code on the ticket and follow the instructions to pay. When exiting the garage, the gate will open by reading your license place.
